content.content: The graph has two relations: depends_on, a node's prerequisites, and evaluates, what a check checks — named thus. A decision carries one or more depends_on and never evaluates; an evaluation carries one or more evaluates and may also carry depends_on. zzzzzzzz names the root and may appear only in depends_on.
content.rationale: Named relations shared by all nodes keep every edge readable the same way; typing at the relation level keeps 'why' apart from 'is it good' so documents and checks cannot smuggle verdicts into dependencies; the root exception anchors recursion without a synthetic node.
